meta.surfaceDefinition: Capabilities describe the most direct official AI-compatible route named for each tool, not every capability in the vendor manual interface.

evidenceBasisDefinition.Documentation reviewed: Assessment based on current official documentation, product announcements and public source repositories.
evidenceBasisDefinition.Connected: The route was authenticated and its advertised tools or commands were inspected.
evidenceBasisDefinition.Executed: At least one representative workflow was run against a controlled account or dataset.
evidenceBasisDefinition.Used repeatedly: The route was used across recurring production work, within the stated boundary.

setupDefinition.Easy: Connect a hosted service and approve access. No developer project or custom code.
setupDefinition.Moderate: Requires account configuration, credentials or a small amount of technical setup.
setupDefinition.Hard: Requires developer access, cloud or OAuth configuration, custom integration work or vendor approval.
setupDefinition.Specialist: Requires data engineering, infrastructure or statistical expertise beyond ordinary campaign operations.

actionDefinition.Yes: The evaluated route directly supports the action for its core objects.
actionDefinition.Partial: The action exists, but important objects, fields or workflows are missing or inconsistent.
actionDefinition.No: The evaluated route does not support the action.
actionDefinition.Depends: The action is determined by connected tools, permissions or custom configuration.
actionDefinition.N/A: The action is not meaningful for this type of tool.
actionDefinition.Unverified: The vendor has not documented a dependable boundary.

coverageDefinition.End to end: Completes nearly all of the recurring human job through the evaluated route.
coverageDefinition.Most steps: Completes most of the recurring job with a bounded human handoff.
coverageDefinition.Some steps: Handles useful parts of the job but leaves material work elsewhere.
coverageDefinition.Assist only: Supplies context or one narrow output rather than completing the job.
coverageDefinition.Depends: Coverage depends on the tools, data or permissions configured by the operator.
coverageDefinition.Specialist: Completes a specialist modelling or engineering job rather than ordinary campaign operations.

meta.commercialDefinition: Affiliate means a public commission-paying programme. Referral and Partner are shown separately and must not be described as affiliate programmes.

capabilityDefinition.Yes: The evaluated route directly supports the action for its core objects.
capabilityDefinition.Partial: The action exists, but important objects, fields or workflows are missing or inconsistent.
capabilityDefinition.No: The evaluated route does not support the action.
capabilityDefinition.Depends: The action is determined by connected tools, permissions or custom configuration.
capabilityDefinition.N/A: The action is not meaningful for this type of tool.
capabilityDefinition.Unverified: The vendor has not documented a dependable boundary.

setup.note: Requires Python, a Google Ads developer token, a Google Cloud project, enabled APIs, OAuth credentials and MCP client configuration.

coverage.note: Account discovery, metadata and GAQL queries. Campaign building and optimisation still happen elsewhere.

google-ads.blocker: It cannot create an ad, change a bid or budget, pause an entity or fix the issue it finds.

commercial.label: Google Partners
commercial.note: Agency recognition, training and support. Not a public cash affiliate programme.

meta-ads.object: Campaigns, ad sets, ads and insights

setup.note: Add the hosted connector and authorise the Meta account. Availability still rolls out by account and tool.

coverage.note: Creation and analysis are present, but the current beta does not provide dependable general modification of existing campaign objects.

meta-ads.blocker: A workflow can create supported objects, then still send the operator back to Ads Manager to make ordinary changes.

commercial.label: Meta Business Partners
commercial.note: Vetted services and technology ecosystem. No public commission-paying Ads affiliate programme was verified.

tiktok-for-business.object: Campaigns, ad groups, ads, audiences, creative and reporting

setup.note: Hosted OAuth connection with no developer token, API key management or custom code.

coverage.note: Around 400 tools cover creation, targeting, bidding, reporting and creative operations. Some manual and account workflows remain outside the route.

tiktok-for-business.blocker: The full endpoint loads an enormous tool surface. Progressive disclosure is safer and easier for daily use.

commercial.label: TikTok for Business Affiliate Program
commercial.note: Impact-hosted programme with a flat-fee bounty for qualified new advertisers.

microsoft-advertising.object: Accounts, campaigns, ad groups, ads, keywords and performance

setup.note: Connect the managed server to a supported assistant and authenticate the advertising account.

coverage.note: Current launch documentation covers exploration, performance queries and audits, not mutation.

microsoft-advertising.blocker: The product language says manage campaigns, but the documented tool boundary only retrieves and audits data.

commercial.label: Microsoft Advertising Partner Program
commercial.note: Agency, channel and technology partner programme with spend and tenure requirements. Not a public affiliate programme.

amazon-ads.object: Campaigns, accounts, reports, billing and selected multi-step workflows

setup.note: Limited to Amazon Ads partners with active API credentials despite the hosted MCP route.

coverage.note: Includes individual API capabilities plus tools for account creation, reports, campaign launch and locale expansion.

amazon-ads.blocker: Strong action coverage is offset by partner-only API access and beta maturity.

commercial.label: Amazon Ads Partner Network
commercial.note: Self-service agency and tool-provider network. Amazon Associates is a separate retail affiliate programme.

setup.note: Requires allowlist access as well as an authenticated advertising account.

coverage.note: Retrieval and analysis only. The broader Marketing API is a separate engineering route.

snapchat-ads.blocker: It is both gated and read-only, so it cannot carry a campaign from diagnosis to correction.

commercial.label: Snapchat Affiliate Programme
commercial.note: PartnerStack programme paying a one-time 20% revenue share on eligible advertiser spend during the first 30 days.

linkedin-ads.object: Campaigns, reporting, audiences, leads and conversions

setup.note: Requires a developer application, a defined use case, product access, application vetting and a custom agent layer.

coverage.note: The API covers important campaign-management jobs, but access is approved by product and use case and there is no official agent interface.

linkedin-ads.blocker: A team cannot simply connect an assistant. It must first win API approval and build and maintain the route.

commercial.label: LinkedIn Marketing Partner Program
commercial.note: Vetted programme with API access, directory visibility and possible incentive or revenue-share programmes. Not an open affiliate scheme.

pinterest-ads.object: Campaigns, ad groups, ads, audiences and reporting

setup.note: Requires a developer application, authorised ad accounts and a custom agent or integration layer.

coverage.note: Useful campaign and reporting coverage through the API, without a vendor-backed MCP, plugin or CLI.

pinterest-ads.blocker: The API is usable, but the AI workflow is yours to engineer and maintain.

commercial.label: Pinterest Business Partners
commercial.note: Vetted media, creative, commerce and measurement ecosystem. No public Ads affiliate programme was verified.

reddit-ads.object: Accounts, campaigns, ad groups, ads and reporting

setup.note: Requires an OAuth application, approved advertising access and a custom agent layer.

coverage.note: Core campaign operations exist in the API, but no official agent interface was verified.

reddit-ads.blocker: API approval and custom integration make this unsuitable as an immediate daily AI workflow.

commercial.label: Reddit Partner Program
commercial.note: Agency, API and data partner programme with badging and directory visibility. No public affiliate commission was verified.

x-ads.surface: Official xurl CLI and Ads API

setup.note: Requires developer and Ads API access, CLI authentication and endpoint-level implementation.

coverage.note: The CLI is agent-friendly, but the general X MCP does not establish Ads coverage and some Ads endpoints are allowlisted.

x-ads.blocker: A useful official CLI exists, but there is no supported Ads-specific MCP or turn-key campaign workflow.

commercial.label: X Official Partner directory
commercial.note: Selected enterprise partner ecosystem. No public X Ads affiliate programme was verified.

display-video-360.object: Advertisers, campaigns, insertion orders, line items, targeting and creatives

setup.note: Requires Google Cloud, OAuth, DV360 account permissions and a custom agent layer.

coverage.note: Broad trafficking coverage, but performance reporting is separate and some YouTube and Partners writes are unsupported.

display-video-360.blocker: An operator needs two API surfaces for build plus performance and still cannot reproduce every manual workflow.

commercial.label: Google Marketing Platform Partners
commercial.note: Certified Company and Sales Partner programme. Not a public affiliate programme.

campaign-manager-360.object: Campaigns, placements, ads, creatives, conversions and reports

setup.note: Requires a CM360 account with API access, user-profile permissions, Google Cloud and OAuth.

coverage.note: Strong trafficking and measurement coverage, but no official agent interface packages the resource model for daily use.

campaign-manager-360.blocker: The API can do serious production work, but permissions and resource complexity demand engineering and a second-person check.

commercial.label: Google Marketing Platform Partners
commercial.note: Certified Company and Sales Partner programme. Not a public affiliate programme.

search-ads-360.object: Campaign, ad, keyword and performance data

setup.note: Requires OAuth application credentials, SA360 account access and a custom agent or reporting layer.

coverage.note: High-volume reporting only. Offline conversion upload is a separate surface and ordinary campaign writes are absent.

search-ads-360.blocker: It can explain the account but cannot perform the optimisation it recommends.

commercial.label: Google Marketing Platform Partners
commercial.note: Certified Company and Sales Partner programme. Not a public affiliate programme.

apple-ads.object: Campaigns, ad groups, keywords and reports

setup.note: Requires an eligible API role, OAuth credentials and custom agent integration. Providers register separately.

coverage.note: Core campaign operations are covered, but no official MCP, agent plugin or daily CLI was verified.

apple-ads.blocker: The official API is capable, but there is no direct assistant workflow without custom implementation.

commercial.label: Apple Ads agency account path
commercial.note: Supports delegated agency management. No Apple Ads-specific public affiliate programme was verified.

the-trade-desk.object: Campaign planning, activation, optimisation and reporting

setup.note: Available only to selected partners through an account representative, with account-managed credentials.

coverage.note: Published scope spans data and actions, but exact tool coverage is not public and access is private beta.

the-trade-desk.blocker: It may be powerful, but most teams cannot evaluate or adopt it without vendor selection.

commercial.label: The Trade Desk partner ecosystem
commercial.note: Vendor partnership route. No public affiliate programme was verified.

google-analytics.object: Property metadata, dimensions, metrics and reports

setup.note: Requires Google Cloud credentials, enabled APIs, property permissions and local or hosted MCP configuration.

coverage.note: Strong querying and reporting, but events, audiences and property settings cannot be changed through the MCP.

google-analytics.blocker: It is useful after implementation, but cannot repair tracking or administer the property it diagnoses.

commercial.label: Google Marketing Platform Partners
commercial.note: Certified Company and Sales Partner programme covering Analytics and Tag Manager. Not a public affiliate programme.

google-tag-manager.object: Accounts, containers, workspaces, tags, triggers and versions

setup.note: Requires Google Cloud OAuth credentials, container permissions and a custom agent or automation layer.

coverage.note: Most configuration objects are available through the API, including version and publish workflows.

google-tag-manager.blocker: There is no official agent interface, and an automated publish can immediately break production tracking.

commercial.label: Google Marketing Platform Partners
commercial.note: Certified Company and Sales Partner programme covering Analytics and Tag Manager. Not a public affiliate programme.

amplitude.object: Charts, dashboards, cohorts, experiments and taxonomy

setup.note: Connect the hosted MCP and authorise an Amplitude user with the appropriate project role.

coverage.note: Strong analytics-asset workflow. Raw event instrumentation and ingestion remain outside the MCP.

amplitude.blocker: The agent can change shared analysis assets and taxonomy, so user permissions and review still matter.

commercial.label: Amplitude Affiliate Program
commercial.note: Public application with commissions for qualified new Starter or Startup customers.

mixpanel.object: Product analytics data and supported assets

setup.note: Connect a compatible MCP client and authorise the Mixpanel account.

coverage.note: The public beta announcement does not document a stable action-by-action write boundary.

mixpanel.blocker: The vendor has not published enough tool-level detail to trust write workflows without inspecting the live connection.

commercial.label: Mixpanel Referral Partners
commercial.note: Open to partners, agencies, marketplaces and independent consultants. Commercial terms depend on the partner arrangement.

figma.object: Design files, components, variables and canvas objects

setup.note: Connect a supported client and authorise Figma. Canvas writes require a Full seat and edit permission.

coverage.note: Excellent design context and code handoff. Write-to-canvas is useful but does not reproduce the full editor or plugin ecosystem.

figma.blocker: A connected agent still cannot rely on every manual design operation, and write access depends on seat type and file permission.

commercial.label: Affiliate programme deprecated
commercial.note: New affiliate applications are closed. A separate Service Partner Program remains available.

canva.object: Designs, assets and selected content workflows

setup.note: Connect and authorise an individual Canva account. App-development workflows have separate requirements.

coverage.note: Useful design creation and editing, without full parity with Canva's manual editor and app ecosystem.

canva.blocker: The Apps CLI is for building Canva apps, not a general daily creative-production CLI.

commercial.label: Affiliate programme sunset
commercial.note: The former affiliate programme is no longer the current route. Canva now promotes partner and creator programmes.

setup.note: Requires a subscription with API access plus authentication for every source queried.

coverage.note: Broad source coverage for retrieval and reporting, but it does not change media-platform objects.

supermetrics.blocker: It moves and queries data only. Entitlements, connector costs and source authentication still shape the workflow.

commercial.label: Supermetrics Affiliate Partner Program
commercial.note: 15% recurring commission for one year at entry tier; 20% for two years after ten successful referrals.

dataforseo.object: SERPs, keywords, backlinks, businesses, products and content data

setup.note: Hosted OAuth is relatively direct; CLI and local MCP use API credentials and module-specific billing.

coverage.note: Wide research-data coverage. It does not read or control the advertiser's own paid-media accounts.

dataforseo.blocker: It is a research input, not a media activation or first-party performance interface.

commercial.label: DataForSEO Affiliate Program
commercial.note: Standard programme pays 25% of a referred user's first payment; the Sheets connector has a separate fixed bounty.

airbyte.object: Connected data sources, destinations and data operations

setup.note: Requires an Airbyte account or instance plus configured sources, destinations, credentials and permissions.

coverage.note: Coverage depends on the connected sources and destinations. Documentation search and action-capable MCP surfaces are distinct.

airbyte.blocker: The MCP does not remove the difficult part: building, authenticating and governing the data connections.

commercial.label: Airbyte partner client referral
commercial.note: Partner page offers a Refer a Client route, but no public commission schedule was verified.

fivetran.surface: Official MCP context layer, public preview
fivetran.object: Connector metadata, schemas and documentation context

setup.note: Requires Fivetran account permissions and a compatible MCP connection.

coverage.note: The MCP supplies context and retrieval. Connector operations remain in the REST API, SDK or product.

fivetran.blocker: The agent surface cannot operate the connectors it describes.

commercial.label: Fivetran Partner Program
commercial.note: Partner programme includes referral incentives, co-selling and reselling; terms vary by tier.

setup.note: Requires deployment or local runtime, database credentials, tools configuration and security design.

coverage.note: Prebuilt database tools and custom YAML definitions can expose broad operations, bounded by the configured role and queries.

google-mcp-toolbox.blocker: It is infrastructure for building a safe interface, not a paid-media connector that works after sign-in.

commercial.label: No product-specific commercial programme verified
commercial.note: General Google Cloud partnership routes are not specific to this open-source toolbox.

setup.note: Requires Snowflake account configuration, Cortex Agent setup, warehouse roles and deliberate tool exposure.

coverage.note: Coverage can be broad, but it depends entirely on schemas, tools, semantic models and role permissions configured by the team.

snowflake.blocker: The quality and safety of the workflow depend on substantial data-platform work before the first useful marketing prompt.

commercial.label: Snowflake Partner Network
commercial.note: Eligible partners can receive referral rebates, service credits and co-marketing support.

setup.note: Create a scoped MCP server, choose actions and authorise the connected apps.

coverage.note: Large app catalogue, but each action must exist in the connector and be explicitly exposed.

zapier.blocker: It is easy to connect but can only do what each Zapier action exposes, while successful MCP calls consume tasks.

commercial.label: Zapier Solution Partner referral benefit
commercial.note: Referral benefit is tied to eligible Solution Partners. Zapier does not offer a general public affiliate programme.

pipedream.object: Actions and APIs in connected applications

setup.note: Pipedream manages connected-app credentials, but the operator must choose apps, actions and permission boundaries.

coverage.note: Broad API and action catalogue, with exact parity determined by the connected component.

pipedream.blocker: The route is flexible rather than opinionated. The team still owns action selection, annotations and production separation.

commercial.label: Pipedream Affiliate Program
commercial.note: Official affiliate application exists; no current public commission rate was visible in the reviewed page.

n8n.object: Enabled workflows and their connected applications

setup.note: Requires an n8n instance, user-scoped access and deliberate enablement of each workflow exposed to MCP clients.

coverage.note: Can trigger powerful multi-step workflows, but the MCP does not automatically expose every node or manual editor feature.

n8n.blocker: The workflow must already be designed and governed. A connected client can trigger credentials and external writes across the enabled set.

commercial.label: n8n Affiliate Partner Program
commercial.note: 30% revenue share for 12 months on eligible Starter and Pro referrals.

meridian.object: Marketing mix models and budget scenarios

setup.note: Requires model-ready historical data, Python, statistical judgement, compute and validation design.

coverage.note: Covers the MMM lifecycle and scenario planning, not live campaign control.

meridian.blocker: It is not an agent or optimiser. Data preparation, priors, model criticism and action rules remain expert work.

commercial.label: Meridian certified partner programme
commercial.note: Selected measurement partners are trained and certified by Google. No public affiliate programme.

robyn.surface: Official open-source R and Python package
robyn.object: Marketing mix models and budget allocation scenarios

setup.note: Requires prepared historical data, R or Python, statistical modelling and validation expertise.

coverage.note: Produces MMM results and allocation hypotheses, without a governed connection to live accounts.

robyn.blocker: Model output is not an approved campaign change. A practitioner must interpret and operationalise it.

commercial.label: No affiliate or partner programme verified
commercial.note: Open-source project rather than a separately sold workflow product.

setup.note: Requires Python, Bayesian modelling expertise, prepared data, compute and model validation.

coverage.note: Flexible modelling toolkit, not a campaign-operation or turn-key daily marketer interface.

pymc-marketing.blocker: Its flexibility increases the amount of expert modelling work required before any media decision is safe.

commercial.label: No affiliate or partner programme verified
commercial.note: Open-source project rather than a separately sold workflow product.

adobe-analytics.object: Report suites, components, reports and workspace projects

setup.note: Connect the hosted endpoint, authenticate and obtain MCP Access plus the product permissions needed for each action.

coverage.note: It completes ad-hoc analysis and creates reusable components or projects; governed interpretation and stakeholder delivery remain human work.

adobe-analytics.blocker: The route is powerful only after an administrator grants MCP access and the Analytics implementation is already trustworthy.

adobe-customer-journey-analytics.object: CJA connections, data views, components, reports and projects

setup.note: Connect the hosted endpoint and authenticate with CJA entitlements, MCP Access and normal product permissions.

coverage.note: Strong analysis and component coverage once the cross-channel data model exists; upstream data design stays outside the route.

adobe-customer-journey-analytics.blocker: The MCP cannot compensate for missing connections, weak identity stitching or badly designed data views.

setup.note: Run the official wizard, authorise a PostHog project and expose the required tools.

coverage.note: The route can investigate behaviour and maintain reusable insights and dashboards; distribution and paid-media decisions remain outside it.

posthog.blocker: It can finish the analytics job, but not the downstream media optimisation job.

appsflyer.object: Apps, campaign performance, attribution and implementation guidance

setup.note: Use hosted OAuth in supported clients or an account-level bearer token for automation.

coverage.note: Useful performance monitoring and implementation diagnosis, without a dependable write route for correcting configuration.

appsflyer.blocker: The beta can explain and audit, then hands configuration changes back to the human or another API workflow.

adjust.object: Attribution data, apps, events, campaigns and test devices

setup.note: Choose and authenticate several APIs, obtain feature enablement where required, then build the agent wrapper.

coverage.note: Broad developer capability exists, but it is fragmented and not presented as a ready AI route.

adjust.blocker: There is no official MCP to connect; the team must design, build and govern the complete agent interface.

segment.object: Sources, destinations, warehouses, tracking plans and events

setup.note: Requires workspace-owner tokens, instrumentation, schemas and a custom agent wrapper around the API.

coverage.note: The Public API can manage core workspace resources, but event design and quality validation still require specialist work.

segment.blocker: The underlying API is capable; the missing piece is an official, safe agent interface for daily operators.

adobe-firefly-creative-production.object: Published creative workflows, images, videos and batch jobs

setup.note: Requires enterprise entitlement, an MCP client and organisation workflows or templates that the server can discover and run.

coverage.note: Can execute and monitor multi-step production workflows, with human brand, legal and final-quality approval.

adobe-firefly-creative-production.blocker: It is not a self-service route for most teams: the enterprise entitlement and reusable workflow design must already exist.

runway.object: Image, video, audio, tasks and workflows

setup.note: Use the official local MCP repository or hosted developer route, then configure billing and authentication.

coverage.note: Creates and transforms production media across modalities; the brief, brand system, rights review and final QC remain human responsibilities.

runway.blocker: The route can make assets, but it cannot decide whether they are on-brand, legally usable or campaign-ready.

ahrefs.object: Keywords, domains, backlinks, competitors and content gaps

setup.note: Connect the hosted endpoint and authenticate an eligible Ahrefs account.

coverage.note: Strong search and competitor research without custom integration; decision framing and activation remain outside the product.

ahrefs.blocker: It provides research evidence, not first-party account performance or campaign action.

semrush.object: SEO, traffic, market, paid-search, shopping and project reports

setup.note: Connect the hosted OAuth endpoint with an eligible subscription and enough API units.

coverage.note: Broad report discovery and execution across Semrush datasets; changes to projects or campaigns stay elsewhere.

semrush.blocker: Read-only access and unit consumption make it an intelligence route, not an operating system for paid media.

similarweb.object: Web, app, search, audience, PPC and retail intelligence

setup.note: Connect the hosted endpoint and authenticate an API-inclusive subscription.

coverage.note: Wide external-market coverage and direct comparisons, bounded by licensed datasets and data-credit economics.

similarweb.blocker: The figures are external estimates and often delayed, so they cannot replace first-party platform or analytics truth.

rudderstack.object: Sources, destinations, transformations and event streams

setup.note: Connect the hosted endpoint and complete OAuth with an authorised RudderStack account.

coverage.note: Useful management coverage for customer-data pipelines, with gaps and stability caveats while the server evolves.

rudderstack.blocker: The vendor explicitly warns that the MCP is incomplete and may change during active development.

databricks.object: SQL, Genie, Vector Search and workspace resources

setup.note: Requires a configured Databricks workspace, managed MCP availability, governed resources and Unity Catalog permissions.

coverage.note: Potentially broad, but every useful marketing workflow depends on the data products and tools an enterprise exposes.

databricks.blocker: The MCP is only the governed access layer; the warehouse and marketing semantic model still have to be built.

dbt.object: dbt projects, semantic metrics, lineage, health, SQL and CLI jobs

setup.note: Install with uvx, point to a local project and enable only the toolsets backed by available dbt Platform or CLI credentials.

coverage.note: Strong analytics-engineering coverage, including build and test, but not a marketer-facing turn-key workflow.

dbt.blocker: A daily operator still needs an analytics engineer to configure the project, credentials and safe tool allowlist.

make.object: Scenarios, connections, webhooks, data stores, teams and organisations

setup.note: Connect the universal OAuth endpoint, select an organisation and grant the minimum required scopes.

coverage.note: Runs existing scenarios directly and can manage workflow entities on paid plans; complex design still benefits from the visual builder.

make.blocker: The agent can only use scenarios reliably when inputs, outputs and descriptions were designed for machine invocation.

workato.object: API collections, recipes, recipe functions and skills

setup.note: An enterprise administrator configures the MCP endpoint, identity, exposed tools and audit policy.

coverage.note: Strong governed execution once recipes and functions are exposed, with coverage determined by enterprise configuration.

workato.blocker: There is no instant universal endpoint: a Workato enterprise setup and administrator-owned tool catalogue come first.

gumloop.object: Agents, sessions, integrations, MCP servers, skills and artifacts

setup.note: Create an account, connect built-in services or public remote MCP endpoints and use the visual builder or CLI.

coverage.note: Strong AI-native workflow construction and execution, with exact depth inherited from each integration and model.

gumloop.blocker: It makes orchestration easy, but it does not remove the need to test every connected action and failure path.
